headline: TCI Express Limited: SEBI Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover Disclosure
sum: TCI Express Limited has made a disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011, signalling a material change in shareholding structure that triggers regulatory filing obligations.
implication: Regulation 29 disclosure marks the point at which an acquirer crosses the 5% threshold (or has made an open offer) and must publicly disclose, triggering the board's obligation to assess fairness and the company's duty to inform stock exchanges within regulatory timelines.
detail: On 14 August 2026, TCI Express Limited informed the NSE of a disclosure under the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011. The filing type 'STXIntimation' (substantial transaction intimation) confirms a material acquisition event. The precise identity of the acquirer, percentage stake acquired, consideration amount, and terms remain undisclosed in the Bar & Bench article; these details are contained within the NSE filing PDF, which serves as the official company intimation to the exchange.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 29
framework.note: Central - Disclosure requirement when acquisition crosses 5% threshold or upon announcement of open offer; acquirer must file within 2 days of crossing threshold.
Central - Definition of 'acquisition of shares'; covers direct and indirect acquisitions and control; applies to listed company shares.
Central - Threshold triggers: 5% (disclosure), 15% (open offer exemption on conditions), 25% (mandatory open offer at floor price), 75% (delisting if required).

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992, Section 23
framework.note: Central - SEBI's powers to issue directions for protection of investor interests and orderly development of securities market.

framework.ref: Listing Regulations (SEBI Listing and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30
framework.note: Central - Obligation of listed entity to make timely disclosures to exchanges of material events including change in control, board composition triggered by substantial shareholding.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013, Section 371(1) / Schedule III, Part II
framework.note: Supporting - Board disclosure of material facts and directors' interest in substantial share acquisitions (if acquirer has board representation).
Central - Open offer requirements: price determination, exemption conditions (25% of voting capital), timing and mode of offer.
Central - Conduct of open offer, acquirer's obligations, shareholder voting, acceptance criteria, and post-offer shareholding scenarios.

conditions: Disclosure of acquisition crossing 5% threshold per Regulation 29
Potential open offer at floor price if 25% or more shares acquired
Regulatory approval for change of control (if applicable to sector)
Stock exchange approval and listing continuance
approvals: NSE/BSE listing committee approval (if delisting or control change)
Sector-specific approvals (if acquirer is foreign or from restricted sector)

triggers.note: Disclosure trigger: Acquirer must file within 2 days of crossing 5% shareholding or announcing open offer.
Open offer trigger: If shareholding reaches 25% or above, mandatory open offer required at floor price unless exemption applies.
Disclosure trigger: Listed company must inform exchanges within 1 hour of receipt of acquirer's Regulation 29 disclosure.
